original.question: Jerry dey roll a six-side die. How much more likely e be (expressed as percentage points) say e roll number wey pasa 3 pass say e roll two even numbers one after the other?
original.answer:
Na 3 numbers wey pasa 3 wey dey for the dice, so chance e get roll one of dem be 3/6=50%.
Chance e get roll one even number be 50%, so chance e get roll two one after the other be 50% * 50% = 25%.
Difference between these two chances be 50% - 25% = 25%.
